children: A new tie-up between US lenders creates an institution with $75 bln in assets and an exit for the private-equity backers of EverBank. It also diversifies the specialty firm, which rode the growth of non-bank upstarts but faces pressure as rules loosen and private credit slows.
Full view will be published shortly.
Follow Stephen Gandel on LinkedIn and X.

EverBank Financial, which is both owned by and specializes in lending to private equity firms, announced on September 7 that it was merging with regional bank WaFD, formerly known as Washington Federal.
JPMorgan and Piper Sandler served as financial advisers to EverBank. Keefe, Bruyette & Woods advised WaFd.
